newsitem.title: USA: IBM reports solid second quarter results.
newsitem.headline: IBM reports solid second quarter results.

text.p: International Business Machines Corp. reported solid second quarter earnings, saying its results showed ongoing strength in its broad product portfolio, despite declines in some of its hardware lines.

IBM reported net income of $1.4 billion, or $1.46 a share, compared with $1.3 billion, or $1.26 last year, adjusted for a two-for-one stock split. IBM's results were in line with Wall Street expectations. According to First Call, the consensus estimate was $1.42 a share.
IBM said that its revenues rose four percent to $18.9 billion, versus $18.2 billion a year ago. On a constant currency basis, revenues climbed eight percent.

IBM said strong results in some businesses -- such as semiconductors, services and hard disk drives -- as well as improved results in mainframes, offset revenue declines in other segments, such as AS/400 minicomputers, RS/6000 workstations and consumer personal computers. IBM said the response to its new mainframe models was good.
IBM also described results from its commercial PCs and PC servers as "good."
